messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: GPU capacity exhausted in us-west-2-prod. 12 pods pending (nvidia.com/gpu). Autoscaler attempted scale-up 3x and failed. Paging on-call

Sara: I’m on it — grabbing context. Which queues/customers impacted?

liaison-cs: Seeing elevated error rates for customer: SynapseAI (prod). They report timeouts on embedding endpoints. CS triage says 20% of requests getting 503/timeout.

Mike: Confirming pods are Pending with reason: "Insufficient nvidia.com/gpu". Also cluster-autoscaler logs show launch failures.

Sara: Ok. Can someone paste the recent autoscaler error?

Mike: Here are the autoscaler errors (trimmed):
```
I0325 14:26:10 scaler.go:312] Scaled up nodegroup eks-gpu-spot-usw2 to 0->2 (max:2)
E0325 14:26:45 aws_manager.go:128] error launching instance: RequestLaunchTemplate: AccessDenied: User: arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/cluster-autoscaler-role is not authorized to call: ec2:RunInstances on resource: launch-template/lt-0a1b2c3d4e5f
E0325 14:27:10 scaler.go:329] failed to increase capacity: AccessDenied
```

alex: That AccessDenied looks like an IAM role change — maybe launch template or role ARN was rotated. infra-bot, any recent infra changes?

infra-bot: Deploy log: launch-template update rolled out last night (version v6). No immediate rollbacks. PR #798 applied.

jamie: Also seeing occasional spot preemptions on existing GPU nodes — interrupts ~5% in the last hour. Could be capacity+preemptions combining.

Sara: Impact priority: customer-facing embedding API degraded. Mitigation plan: 1) temporarily increase ASG desired capacity for non-spot GPU pool to bypass spot launch template, 2) rollback launch-template version or grant CA role RunInstances for new template, 3) auto-fallback route: route heavy traffic to cpu-backed model instances (if possible). Which step can we execute fastest?

Mike: I can try increasing ASG desired on dedicated-gpu-asg from 2->4 (if limit allows). That will use a different launch configuration that the CA isn't trying to touch. But need approval to bump quota.

Sara: Do it. Post the command you run.

Mike: Running: 
```
aws autoscaling set-desired-capacity --auto-scaling-group-name dedicated-gpu-asg --desired-capacity 4 --region us-west-2
```

ops-bot: Command accepted, desired capacity set to 4. Scaling activity started.

Mike: New instances started but one failed to join cluster — kubelet never registered. Checking cloud-init logs.

alex: Any node-level taint/label mismatch preventing kubelet from joining? Also check kubelet token or user-data errors.

Mike: Found user-data error: kubeadm join failed due to: certificate expired for token. Log: 
```
[ERROR] kubeadm: failed to join: x509: certificate has expired or is not yet valid
```

Sara: That explains manual nodes failing. We need working nodes fast. Options: 1) fix token/rotate bootstrap certs via userdata, 2) re-launch nodes using older/known-good AMI/launch-template version. Which is faster?

infra-bot: We can revert to launch-template v5 (last known-good) immediately. Revert requires approval from infra leads. Jamie, Alex?

alex: Approve rollback. Do it and confirm CA can call RunInstances. Also temporarily attach policy to cluster-autoscaler role to allow RunInstances until we fix the template IAM bindings properly.

jamie: Approving rollback. Also will open a follow-up to restrict the policy after incident.

infra-bot: Rolling back launch-template to v5 now.

ops-bot: Launch-template reverted to v5.

Mike: Triggering scale again on CA side — requesting nodes.

cluster-autoscaler-bot: Scale-up request accepted, launching 3 nodes.

Mike: New nodes coming up. Two registered, one still pending kubelet join — looks healthy otherwise. Pods are scheduling onto GPU nodes. Pending queue dropped from 12 -> 3 in ~4 minutes.

liaison-cs: Customer SynapseAI confirms reduced error rate to ~5%. They'll keep monitoring.

Sara: Good. Next steps while we stabilize:
- Keep dedicated pool at higher desired=4 for 30min
- Revoke temporary RunInstances permission after template rollback tested
- Rotate/refresh node bootstrap tokens and update userdata image to avoid x509 error
- Postmortem to track root cause: why launch-template rollout broke CA permissions and why token expired without detection

Mike: Opening emergency PR to patch userdata and add a preflight test for kubeadm join during launch-template promotion.

jamie: I'll run quota check and request permanent ASG quota increase if we need headroom for peak load.

Sara: Thanks all. I’ll update incident channel and create a P0 postmortem. tagging @liaison-cs for customer follow-up.

liaison-cs: I’ll send an interim note to SynapseAI and offer degraded-mode workaround (route to CPU-only endpoint) until postmortem complete.

oncall-bot: Incident acknowledged by Sara. Severity: Sev2 -> customer impact contained.

Mike: Final state: pending pods=1, scheduled=11, autoscaler healthy after rollback. Leaving dedicated pool at 4 for 30m.

Sara: End of active mitigation. Will keep channel open for follow-up actions. :white_check_mark:
